name: amni-shield
description: Blocks harmful and distracting websites using custom domain lists, keyword filters, and scheduled blocking rules.

scripts.zip: wxt zip && mkdir -p dist && cp -a .output/*.zip dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.zip:firefox: wxt zip -b firefox && mkdir -p dist && cp -a .output/*.zip dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dist: npm run zip && npm run zip:firefox
scripts.test: npx tsx tests/content-blockers.test.ts && npx tsx tests/url-matcher.test.ts
